title: Gate dynamic package loading behind stable manifests
summary: Defer dynamic capability package loading until package manifests are stable across generated math, graph, programming, and export examples.

sourceRefs.summary: Export dependency manifest path that should remain compatible with package loading.

expectedLearning: Which manifest fields are stable enough to become loader input.
How exported capsules should declare critical, interactive, optional, and fallback package phases.
What security and dependency closure checks must pass before runtime loading.
allowedWork: Keep this gated until manifests have cross-domain evidence.
Use package manifests as metadata contracts before loading code dynamically.
disallowedWork: Do not implement a dynamic loader yet.
Do not ship package splitting until generated math, graph, programming, and export examples agree on manifests.
revisitWhen: After package manifests are stable across generated math, graph, programming, and export examples.
